component.name: Blink
component.summary: Privacy-first biometric Face ID and face unlock for Linux

description.p: Blink brings ultra-fast, 100% offline biometric facial recognition unlock to Linux desktops. Powered by lightweight YuNet face detection and 512-dimensional ArcFace deep Euclidean embeddings, Blink verifies your identity locally on CPU in under 15ms with zero telemetry and zero cloud calls.

ul.li: 100% Offline: All neural weights run strictly on your local device.
Instant Screen Unlock: Sub-25ms virtual hardware injection via /dev/uinput.
Apple-grade Lockscreen UI: Sleek squircle floating biometric card matching desktop lockscreens.
Low Resource Footprint: Uses less than 150 MB RAM and runs smoothly on standard modern CPUs.
Universal Camera Support: Compatible with standard USB webcams, integrated laptop cameras, and infrared (IR) sensors.

description.p: Exact Figma 200x180 password entry pill layout with centered 170x38 input box, crisp placeholder, and persistent 0.7 opacity cross button at (163, 23); fix X11 64-bit display pointer segfault in unminimize_x11_window so unlocked apps pop directly into foreground over the current window; and eliminate password-submit unlock latency via pre-warmed key cache and async metadata/notification dispatch.

Smooth in-pill expansion from the Face ID scanning animation into the 200x180 Figma password entry card when face detection fails (with click-to-retry padlock), instant foreground window raise/focus on unlock, and smart Blink Lock features (1-click Quick Re-Lock history, drag-and-drop vault encryption, auto re-lock on screen lock, and instant panic lock).

Fix file and folder unlock execution with Dynamic Island top notch overlay, resolve background daemon app interception NameErrors, fix archive permission handling, and add robust service restart on upgrade.

Dynamic Island top notch unlock animation for apps and files, fast in-daemon biometric verification (<400ms), sleek dark Blink password fallback dialog with direct keyboard focus, and automatic real-time sync of file manager locked items in Settings.
Test update release to verify the in-app automated update fetching and installation pipeline.
In-place folder and file locking with dynamic red folder indicator and lock emblems, fixed locked app launch and unminimization, multi-cycle Face ID retry with automated password fallback modal.
Windows compatibility improvements and packaging updates.
Fixed enrollment preview camera freeze on landmark alignment, optimized lockscreen face detection to 480p, tuned biometric threshold matching, and reduced liveness false positives.
Fixed in-app self-updater UI with Gtk.Revealer, added clear modal feedback, resolved pkexec updater imports, and restored Windows independence for multi-agent collaboration.
Optimized enrollment performance with 480p downscaled face detection, added lockscreen Windows (Super) key wakeup trigger, and fixed lockscreen daemon stability.
Resolved multi-face unlock and single-face sluggishness; added native in-app self-updater and GitHub release synchronizer.
Blink release with optimized YuNet 5-point landmark detection and lockscreen biometric overlay.
